pages.text: During a ball game, the ball flew high and caught on a tree branch.
"I will get that ball down." Mio looked up at the tree.
Mio jumped again and again. Those fingertips were nowhere near the branch.
Mio shook the trunk. Only leaves fluttered down.
Duri brought a long stick. Mio pushed it back toward Duri.
The sun sank, stretching shadows across the yard. The ball was still on the branch.
Mio leaned against the tree trunk. Nobody could play ball.
Teacher Bau stood beside Mio. "Mio, who is tallest here?"
Mio raised both arms. "Teacher, please help me."
Mio came down from Teacher Bau's shoulders, hugging the ball. The children waited with open arms. "Catch!"
